sentences.text: No, it would not be compliant to only mention the bank’s online schedule of penal charges in the sanction letter and loan documents, because the directions require the quantum and reason for penal charges to be clearly disclosed upfront in the loan agreement and KFS as applicable, in addition to being displayed on the UCB’s website. [type:fact]
The directions also say that providing only a reference to the website schedule in the sanction letter and loan agreement shall not suffice. [type:fact]
